perm.lockedByRole: Locked for your role by an admin.
perm.fredy.read.label: Fredy: read
perm.fredy.read.desc: Jobs, listings, photos, application letters, financing calculator – all Fredy tools that only read.
perm.fredy.write.label: Fredy: write
perm.fredy.write.desc: Fredy's own write tools: notes, watchlist, creating jobs by interview – and whatever Fredy adds in the future.
perm.listings.hide.label: Delete (hide) and restore listings
perm.listings.hide.desc: Like “Delete” in the Fredy interface: the listing disappears and does not come back with the next search. Can be undone at any time.
perm.listings.hard_delete.label: Delete listings permanently
perm.listings.hard_delete.desc: Removes listings from the database for good. If a listing is still online, Fredy reports it as new again on the next run.
perm.listings.status.label: Set application status
perm.listings.status.desc: Mark listings as applied, rejected or accepted – or clear the status.
perm.listings.scam.label: Mark potential scams
perm.listings.scam.desc: Mark listings as scam or as no scam – or take the verdict back.
perm.listings.details.label: Refresh listing details
perm.listings.details.desc: Like “Refresh” under a listing's description: Fredy fetches the detail page from the portal again, e.g. when the text is cut off. Limited to one at a time and {{perHour}} per hour, so the portal does not block you.
perm.jobs.run.label: Run jobs now
perm.jobs.run.desc: Start a search outside the schedule.
perm.jobs.toggle.label: Enable and pause jobs
perm.finance.read.label: View finance profile
perm.finance.read.desc: Read your settings from Fredy's financing page: incomes, living costs, existing loans, purchase settings and loan scenarios.
perm.finance.write.label: Change finance profile
perm.finance.write.desc: Change those settings – they drive Fredy's affordability verdicts and filters. Only the fields mentioned are changed.
consent.title: Approve connection
consent.lead: {{client}} wants to connect to your Fredy account {{user}}.
consent.existing: This client is already connected. Your selection below replaces its current permissions.
consent.footnote: You can change the permissions, block individual Fredy tools or disconnect at any time.
conn.revokeConfirm: Really disconnect? The client loses access immediately.
conn.lockedByCeiling: Currently locked by the role limit
dash.title: Overview
dash.proxyWarning: Fredy does not confirm your user via “Sign-in handled by the reverse proxy”. Tools only work once it is set up in Fredy.
dash.connectorLead: Add this address to your MCP client – in Claude under {{path}}. You will then land here to approve the connection.
dash.mineEmpty: No connections yet. Add the URL above to your MCP client.
dash.rolesDesc: Defines which permissions admins and users may grant to their connections at all.
connPage.title: Edit permissions
connPage.lead: Fredy account {{user}}. Changes apply from the next tool call.
connPage.toolsNote: Applies in addition to the permissions above. Tools that Fredy adds in the future are allowed automatically as long as the matching Fredy permission is on.
connPage.toolsUnavailable: Fredy's tool list is not available right now: {{error}}
connPage.ownerUnconfirmed: Fredy does not confirm the owner of this connection right now.
roles.title: Role limits
roles.lead: The most that members of a Fredy role may grant to their connections. Removing a permission here switches it off immediately in all connections of that role – the users' selection is kept and applies again once you grant it back.
roles.note: Regardless of this, every user only sees and changes what Fredy allows them (their own jobs and jobs shared with them).
check.proxy: Sign-in handled by the reverse proxy
check.endpointsMissing: No longer available – Fredy has changed its API: {{list}}
check.endpointsOk: All {{count}} endpoints in use are available.
check.proxyPending: Not checkable yet: a Fredy admin has to sign in to the bridge once.
check.proxyNotAdmin: “{{user}}” is no longer an admin in Fredy – other users' MCP tokens cannot be fetched.
check.proxyRejected: Fredy does not accept the bridge. In Fredy under Administration → System → “Sign-in handled by the reverse proxy”: switch it on and check the bridge IP, header names and secret.
